## Selected work

- MindPath — Website and Web App. Online mental-health service in Ireland for adult ADHD and autism assessment.
- Otee — Web and Mobile apps. Online laundry service platform: customer ordering, driver pickups, kiosk POS, admin operations.
- Appello — Mobile App. Field-based responder assistance, primarily for people who live alone.
- ValueHut — Website. Agile management consultancy transforming organisations into product-team networks.
- Codex — SaaS. Headless CMS for publishers, focused on rapid content creation.
- AI Journey — AI SaaS. AI analyst for marketing teams explaining why visitors leave and suggesting one fix.

## Tracks

- AI Workflow (3+ years): the loop between people and agents — prompts, tools, guardrails.
- Design Systems (5+ years): tokens, components, docs that grow with team and product.
